files.ROADMAP.md:
# FilmCircle Roadmap

## Product contract

Registered users form private clubs, nominate and select films, record group watch sessions, rate watched films, and build shared and personal history. All capabilities below are MVP.

## Current phase plan

### Phase 0 — Setup
Repository setup, design system, public site, authentication, and club roles.

### Phase 1 — Core product
Club invitations, film-provider search, session creation, nominations, voting, watching, ratings, history, and personal library.

### Phase 2 — Finish
Statistics, achievements, notifications, profile/privacy/export/deletion, subscriptions, app administration, PWA/mobile, security, monitoring, SEO, and production deployment.

## Progress

No application implementation has started.

expectations: Uses focused update mode and preserves every approved MVP capability without creating unrelated guidance artifacts
Replaces the oversized activity buckets with dependency-ordered delivery phases that each have one independently verifiable outcome
Gives delivery phases visible dependencies, capability-level scope, acceptance checks, evidence requirements, deliverables, and explicit exclusions
Introduces human verification and bug-fixing checkpoints after each five-to-six-phase delivery block and states that they supplement normal phase tests
Defines severity-based checkpoint exit criteria so release-blocking findings cannot be carried into the next delivery block
Separates release readiness, final human acceptance, and production deployment into distinct acceptance boundaries
Uses progressive elaboration and a linked temporary active-phase document lifecycle without inventing future file, endpoint, or schema details
Does not mark unimplemented work complete or invent unsupported numeric product constraints
